## First release of this fork

This release is **identical to upstream [sndyuk/logback-more-appenders](https://github.com/sndyuk/logback-more-appenders) 1.8.9**.
It is built from the same source ([`de07adb`](https://github.com/sndyuk/logback-more-appenders/tree/de07adbc1942d95381d7be0421863e6707125dde)),
with the same dependency versions, as [`com.sndyuk:logback-more-appenders:1.8.9`](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.sndyuk/logback-more-appenders/1.8.9).

Only the Maven coordinates change. To switch, replace the groupId and keep everything else:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.github.montss</groupId>
  <artifactId>logback-more-appenders</artifactId>
  <version>1.8.9</version>
</dependency>
```

Java package names and appender class names are unchanged, so existing `logback.xml` and `logback-spring.xml`
files keep working.

Other changes, none of which affect the published classes:

- Full Apache License 2.0 text in `LICENSE`, plus a `NOTICE` file. License URLs now use `https`.
- CI build on every pull request, and automated releases to Maven Central and GitHub.
- A [roadmap](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for upcoming releases.
